about_the_game:
The official art appreciation pack for Find Love or Die Trying: Til Death Do Us Part! Don't look inside till you've finished the game, as there's spoilers!

---

Hi there! I'm Auden Cho-Wong, the creator of Find Love or Die Trying. If you've enjoyed my work and would like to support my future projects, you can get the art appreciation pack! The support really goes a long way in helping me make more games for you.

As a small token of appreciation, the art appreciation pack comes loaded with over 70+ original artworks & concept artworks, a digital booklet with never-before-seen behind-the-scenes content into the making of the game, and my gratitude for helping me make more games! I hope you enjoy it as much as I enjoyed creating this game for you.

Sincerely,

Auden Cho-Wong

P.S.

You'll be able to access all of the above by going into FLODT: Til Death Do Us Part's Properties and clicking the "Browse Local Files" button. This will take you to the game directory, which has the Art Appreciation Pack included in it.
